propositions: Recursive conftest glob pattern tests/**/conftest.py in global_support causes all seven mutation shards to be selected for any nested conftest change, regardless of whether tests in that shard load those fixtures.

Runtime tracing of configured shards reveals pytest loads only six ancestor conftests: tests/conftest.py plus five non-root ancestors; sibling conftest trees like tests/external/live_jira_dc/conftest.py are never loaded by any shard.

Unrelated nested conftest changes that match the recursive glob pattern consumed 322.6 runner-minutes (5.38 runner-hours) across 97 recent Verify runs without increasing coverage or fixing genuine issues.

Manifest mutation-gate contract must derive per-shard ancestor-conftest closure from configured test paths, verify each non-root conftest appears only in support lists of shards that actually load it, and fail when a required ancestor is missing or stale entries exist.
Each non-root ancestor conftest must be assigned to exactly the mutation shards whose configured tests load it through pytest's upward-only conftest discovery.
Post-fix verification confirms 374 test pass/skip results unchanged, unrelated nested conftests select zero shards, and declared ancestor conftest changes select exactly their dependent shards.
